title: A Strong Tower
subtitle: A reflection on Proverbs 18:10

beats.label: Begin
beats.narration: Welcome to Daily Breath. Take a slow breath and let your shoulders soften. Today, we’ll rest with one image of safety: a strong tower.
beats.visualPrompt: Quiet morning light across a simple room; soft greens and warm cream; slow camera drift.

beats.label: Verse of the Day
beats.narration: Our Verse of the Day is Proverbs 18:10: “The LORD’s name is a strong tower: the righteous run to him, and are safe.” This verse pictures God’s name—God’s character and faithfulness—as a place to turn when we need refuge.
beats.onScreenText: The LORD’s name is a strong tower.
beats.visualPrompt: A sturdy stone tower above a peaceful landscape at sunrise; scripture reference appears quietly.

beats.label: Reflect
beats.narration: A tower does not make the storm imaginary. It offers shelter while the storm is real. Faith can be like that: not denial, but a trusted place to bring fear, grief, and uncertainty. The verse invites us to turn toward God rather than face every burden alone.
beats.onScreenText: Bring the real thing into prayer.
beats.visualPrompt: Rain passes beyond a sheltered stone arch; warm light rests inside while the landscape remains visible.

beats.label: Consider
beats.narration: What feels heavy or uncertain today? You don’t need to solve it in this moment. Name it honestly. What would it mean to seek refuge before rushing to fix everything?
beats.visualPrompt: A journal beside a window; a hand writes one honest concern in morning light.

beats.label: Practice
beats.narration: Take one quiet minute. Breathe in, and remember you are not required to carry everything alone. Breathe out, and offer God the concern you named. If support from another person would help, choose someone safe to contact today.
beats.visualPrompt: A calm pause beside an open window, followed by a phone placed next to a handwritten note.

beats.label: Pause
beats.narration: For a few breaths, be still. Breathe in: refuge. Breathe out: I can ask for help. Let the words settle without forcing yourself to feel a certain way.
beats.onScreenText: Refuge. One breath at a time.
beats.visualPrompt: Still leaves moving gently in a light breeze; hold a spacious, quiet frame.

beats.label: Prayer
beats.narration: Present God, help me receive your care and recognize the people you have placed beside me. Be my refuge in what feels uncertain. Give me courage for the next step, and humility to reach out when I need help. Amen.
beats.visualPrompt: Warm light across an open Bible on a table; gentle stillness without depicting a specific religious figure.

beats.label: Carry this with you
beats.narration: May you find refuge for this moment and courage for your next step. This has been Daily Breath.
beats.visualPrompt: A calm sunrise over a simple horizon; fade slowly to the Daily Breath mark.

sources.notes: Bible Verse of the Day text is from the public-domain WEB. Reflection, practice, and prayer are original.

outroText: May you find refuge for this moment.
